equations.one_dimensional: d_t h+d_s(hu)=0; d_t(hu)+d_s(hu^2+g*h^2/2)=-g*h*d_s z - h*[mu*g*cos(theta)+g*u*abs(u)/(xi*h)] along horizontal path station, constant effective width chosen to match raster source volume; no entrainment
equations.two_dimensional: Cartesian graph shallow-water d_t h+div(h u)=0; d_t(h u)+div(h u tensor u+g*h^2/2 I)=-g*h*grad(z)-h*[mu*g*cos(theta)+g*|u|^2/(xi*h)]*u/|u|; hydrostatic pressure factor 1, no curvature/active-passive stress, homogeneous bulk material

numerics.spatial: first-order finite volume, local Rusanov flux, Audusse hydrostatic reconstruction and side-specific bed pressure corrections
numerics.time: forward Euler conservative transport plus implicit scalar Coulomb/Voellmy contraction
numerics.mass_depth_clipping: negative roundoff only, measured volume correction; negative depth below -1e-8 fails
numerics.boundary: zero-gradient transmissive ghost cells; numerical signed boundary flux explicitly booked; inflow tracked separately, not hidden
numerics.solver_identity: independent research implementation; neither RAMMS nor r.avaflow nor D-Claw
numerics.steep_topography_limit: hydrostatic reconstruction may suppress downslope acceleration when bed steps exceed flow depth; measure steep-cell ratio and perform incline/grid checks; no claim of full avalanche physics

regional_scenarios.design: one-factor-at-a-time around reference, plus path ensemble for 1D and 120m/CFL-half references; not a probability sample
regional_scenarios.density_role: explicit illustrative homogeneous bulk density; does not affect these volume/momentum equations; not measured
regional_scenarios.release_volume: sum(thickness raster)*cell area; 120m raster normalized to same 60m reference release area-volume where source raster differs

required_outputs: target first sampled step h>=0.1; saved interval brackets arrival
one-dimensional transport volume and path profiles
benchmarks: closed-wall lake at rest over smooth bed with wet/dry edge
flat dry-bed dam break against Ritter rarefaction, grid refinement
2D radial release dry-front positivity/closed mass symmetry
uniform inclined layer grid dependence and Voellmy terminal velocity comparison
scope_limits: no local calibration or independent event validation
no existing river water, ice melting, phase separation, pore pressure, erosion or substrate entrainment
static versus deposited unresolved: final h is residual material, stationary only if speeds meet threshold
cell-centre buffered targets miss subgrid facilities; 1D uses its own path-buffer cell intersection
